title: Destination
description: Destination for the task. Use `businessAddress` type for `workItem` tasks and `dialNumber` type for `telephony` tasks.

id.description: Destination identifier. For `workItem` tasks, this is the business address associated with the configured workItem channel entry point. For `telephony` tasks, this is the dial number to call. **Migrating from v1:** Previously the top-level `destination` field (plain string) for telephony.

type.description: Destination type. Use `businessAddress` for `workItem` tasks and `dialNumber` for `telephony` tasks.
